newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM June palladium futures surge by daily limit.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM June palladium futures surge by daily limit.

text.p: Yen-based June palladium futures on the Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) rose by their 22 yen per gram daily limit at the opening on Wednesday, in reaction to a rally overnight in New York, traders said.
The spot June palladium futures rose by 22 yen from Tuesday's close to 638 yen per gram at the opening.
Other contracts also rose at the opening, with the benchmark April 1998 contract up 12 yen at 583 yen.

Active buying from local investors supported the yen-based palladium market, traders said. Traders said they would carefully watch the Russia/Japan platinum group metal (PGM) export talks, due to be held in Tokyo early June.
